name: visa_france_visas_form
description: Step-by-step companion through the France-Visas online application form at france-visas.gouv.fr. The form has 10 sections (Section 0 Visa-Wizard through Section 9 Submit). Without a current_section, returns an overview of all sections and a progress checklist. With current_section set to 0-9, returns field-level guidance, common pitfalls, and consistency checks for that specific section. Call repeatedly as the applicant works through the form.

current_section.description: Section number 0-9 to get detailed guidance for. Omit for an overview of all sections.

travel_dates.description: Travel dates in natural language or ISO

stay_days.description: Number of days in the Schengen area

first_entry_country.description: First Schengen country of entry — may differ from France if flying via another member state

entries_requested.description: Number of entries — request multiple if you may leave and re-enter Schengen
